reconstructed_a_vs_original_a.diagnostic_note: Only mean_term and covariance_term sum to FID. Variance and correlation mismatch rankings are non-additive diagnostics.

reconstructed_a_vs_reconstructed_b.diagnostic_note: Only mean_term and covariance_term sum to FID. Variance and correlation mismatch rankings are non-additive diagnostics.

reconstructed_a_vs_original_b.diagnostic_note: Only mean_term and covariance_term sum to FID. Variance and correlation mismatch rankings are non-additive diagnostics.

original_a_vs_original_b.diagnostic_note: Only mean_term and covariance_term sum to FID. Variance and correlation mismatch rankings are non-additive diagnostics.

definitions.psnr_db: RGB PSNR in dB on [0,1]; higher is better; MSE is floored at 1e-12 (maximum 120 dB)
definitions.ssim: RGB SSIM on [0,1], Gaussian 11x11 window; higher is better
definitions.lpips_vgg: Training-matched taming VGG-LPIPS on [-1,1]; lower is better

paired_reconstruction_metrics.pairing: Each center-cropped source image is compared with its own reconstruction

analysis_explanation.mean_term: Squared distance between Inception feature means
analysis_explanation.covariance_term: Difference in feature spread and covariance structure
analysis_explanation.same_image_reconstruction: reconstructed_A vs original_A isolates reconstruction shift
analysis_explanation.split_baseline: original_A vs original_B estimates finite-sample/split noise
analysis_explanation.feature_rankings: Variance/correlation rankings are diagnostic and do not sum to FID
